justification: The counterexample is exactly the reference process, with renamed independent signs. All variables are bounded and integrable. Both one-step identities hold, including E[X_3 | X_2=0]=(1−1)/2=0. On {X_1=1, X_2=0}, an event of probability 1/4, E[X_3 | F_2]=1 differs from X_2=0, violating the martingale condition.
